        int v, cost, flow;
        Edge rev;
        public Edge(int v, int flow, int cost) {
            this.v = v; this.flow = flow; this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static final int Z = 100;
    static final int N = Z * Z;
    static final int M = Z * Z * Z * 3;

    static List<Edge>[] adj = new ArrayList[N];
    static int[] px = new int[N], py = new int[N], head = new int[N], d_arr = new int[N], vis = new int[N], pre = new int[N], id = new int[N];
    static int tot;

    public static void solve() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        final int s = 0;
        final int t = n * 100 + 1;

        // Initialize adjacency list
        init();

        // Add edge function
        BiConsumer<Integer, Integer> addEdge = (u, v) -> {
            // This method is kept as placeholder
        };

        // Function to add edges
        class Graph {
            void add(int u, int v, int flow, int cost) {
                Edge e1 = new Edge(v, flow, cost);
                Edge e2 = new Edge(u, 0, -cost);
                e1.rev = e2;
                e2.rev = e1;
                adj[u].add(e1);
                adj[v].add(e2);
            }
        }

        Graph graph = new Graph();

        // Add edges for sink nodes
        for (int i = 1; i <= 100; i++) {
            graph.add(i, t, 100, 0);
        }

        // Add initial source connections
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            int v = sc.nextInt();
            graph.add(s, (v - 1) * 100 + 1, 1, 0);
        }

        // Build the graph
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; ++j) {
                graph.add((i - 1) * 100 + j, (i - 1) * 100 + j + 1, 100, c);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            int u = sc.nextInt();
            int v = sc.nextInt();
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; ++j) {
                int idx = (u - 1) * 100 + j;
                int idy = (v - 1) * 100 + j + 1;
                for (int k = 1; k <= 50; ++k) {
                    int costVal = c + (k * k - (k - 1) * (k - 1)) * d;
                    graph.add(idx, idy, 1, costVal);
                }
            }
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; ++j) {
                int idx = (v - 1) * 100 + j;
                int idy = (u - 1) * 100 + j + 1;
                for (int k = 1; k <= 50; ++k) {
                    int costVal = c + (k * k - (k - 1) * (k - 1)) * d;
                    graph.add(idx, idy, 1, costVal);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxFlow(s, t));

    }

    static void init() {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            adj[i].clear();
        }
        tot = 0;
    }

    static boolean spfa(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(d_arr, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        Arrays.fill(vis, 0);
        Arrays.fill(pre, -1);
        d_arr[s] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            vis[u] = 0;
            for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                int v = e.v;
                if (e.flow > 0 && d_arr[v] > d_arr[u] + e.cost) {
                    d_arr[v] = d_arr[u] + e.cost;
                    pre[v] = u;
                    id[v] = u; // placeholder for edge index
                    if (vis[v] == 0) {
                        vis[v] = 1;
                        q.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return d_arr[t] < Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    }

    static int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        int flowSum = 0;
        int totalCost = 0;
        while (spfa(s, t)) {
            int augment = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int i = t; i != s; i = pre[i]) {
                for (Edge e : adj[pre[i]]) {
                    if (e.v == i && e.flow > 0) {
                        augment = Math.min(augment, e.flow);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = t; i != s; i = pre[i]) {
                for (Edge e : adj[pre[i]]) {
                    if (e.v == i && e.flow > 0) {
                        e.flow -= augment;
                        e.rev.flow += augment;
                        totalCost += e.cost * augment;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            flowSum += augment;
        }
        return totalCost;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        solve();
    }
